text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to unblock phoenix-13b for the catalog launch. Major open items: license sign-off, embeddings shape + dtype for the hosted embeddings endpoint, perf profile (latency/cost), and clear ownership for canary.

aj: I ran a quick perf sweep on a small shard. Generation looks fine. 8k context, greedy decode median latency ~210ms for 1k tokens on vram-32. Embedding encoder returns 1536-d floats by default (float32).

kevin: Legal flag — license in the model repo is 'CC-BY-NC-4.0' with some third-party components. That NC clause could block commercial hosting. Need a confirmation from the upstream maintainer or a separate commercial license.

samir: Catalog side: ingest manifest uploaded, metadata fields: name, weights_url, model_card_url present. Missing: inference_config and embeddings_spec (shape/dtype). I'm holding publish until embedding shape is explicit.

olive: Runtime note: 1536-d float32 embeddings will increase memory and network egress. We can offer a quantized float16 variant, but we need a validated quality regression check. Also planning: KV cache optimization for 8k context will shave ~15% latency.

maya: Thanks. @kevin can you confirm whether we require a legal change or temporary mitigation (e.g., mark as "restricted" in catalog and block hosted usage)? We need a decision by EOD Fri to hit the launch date.

kevin: I'll ping upstream; also running our license-scan tool now — will post the output. If upstream refuses relicensing, mark as restricted-only (private/dedicated) and flag in catalog UI.

aj: For embeddings: I can export a float16 baseline and run evals on our embedding eval set (semantic-similarity + clustering). If float16 drops <1% on primary metric we can default to float16 + shape 1536. If not, we expose both shapes and let customers pick.

samir: Workflow-wise: I need the exact embeddings_spec string to drop into the manifest. Example I expect: "\"embeddings_spec\": { \"dims\": 1536, \"dtype\": \"float16\" }". If you confirm dtype I can schedule the catalog ingest.

olive: Also callout — the dedicated infra team needs an estimate of peak throughput (rps) for the canary. @maya can you ask product if they expect embeddings-heavy traffic on day1?

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: staging -> canary on 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC if no blockers. Triggered by release 2026.04.12-rc3.

maya: Action items: 1) @kevin — license scan + upstream ping (owner) 2) @aj — float16 embedding eval + perf baseline (owner) 3) @samir — hold manifest until embeddings_spec confirmed, prepare restricted tag if needed 4) @olive — estimate memory/throughput for canary and KV cache opt plan. Please reply here when done. Target: decision by 2026-04-10 EOD. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aj: I'll post evals by tomorrow morning and include a small script snippet for converting to float16:```python
import torch
emb = model.embed(input_ids)
emb = emb.half()  # cast to float16
save(emb)
```

kevin: Posted license-scan output: found NC clause + third-party tokenizer under different terms. Upstream ping sent, copying thread. If no reply in 48h we should default to restricted hosting.

samir: Noted. I'll prepare the restricted-only UI marker and flag the model in the preflight checklist.

maya: Great progress. Please keep updates short here. I'll compile the final gating checklist once all owners confirm. :thumbsup:
